summary.en-US: Send pictures, videos, songs and links to Kodi from the right-click menu or the toolbar button.

description.en-US:
Play what you're looking at on Kodi.

- Right-click a picture, video, song or link: **Send to Kodi** or **Queue on Kodi**.
- Toolbar button: send the current page, e.g. a YouTube video.

Setup: enter Kodi's address in the options, and in Kodi enable Settings › Services › Control › Allow remote control via HTTP. YouTube needs Kodi's YouTube add-on; other video sites need SendToKodi.

Pictures without a file extension go through the wsrv.nl image proxy. You can turn this off in the options.

Source: https://github.com/hugoocoto/browser2kodi

version.approval_notes: Needs Kodi with Settings > Services > Control > Allow remote control via HTTP enabled; enter its address in the options. The extension only talks to that address. Pictures without a file extension are sent to Kodi as a wsrv.nl URL, which Kodi fetches. Source: https://github.com/hugoocoto/browser2kodi
